The AP control account 2000 should carry the invoice amount. Without the invoice amount, I have to choose between the debit and the credit as the wrong side. My notes say the net AP credit balance roughly matches open invoices. The notes say the DR side (6654.87) would then be short by 9.00, and a one-sided line is allowed. A transposition (6654.87 vs 6663.87) is more plausible on the expense line, since 54 and 63 are not mere digit swaps either way. The two figures can't be told apart by looking at them, so I'll rely on the AP control credit as the reference.

The correction is a one-sided debit of 9.00 to 5100 in open period 11. That brings the 5100 debit total to 6663.87, which equals the credit to 2000, and the journal group balances. No invoice status changes are needed.
